facts.label: Core coverage
facts.text: Allstate describes dwelling, personal property, liability and additional living expenses after a covered loss makes the home uninhabitable.

facts.label: Important exclusions
facts.text: Its overview lists flood, earth movement, water backup and wear or maintenance problems among general exclusions. Check endorsements and the actual policy for exceptions and limits.

facts.label: Pricing and bundling
facts.text: Premiums depend on home age and location, belongings, claims and deductibles. Home and auto bundling is available in many states; request the actual combined price.
